response.sql: SELECT p.SEX AS sex, AVG(CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(l.DNA), '') AS REAL)) AS average_anti_dna, AVG(l.ALB - l.TP) AS average_albumin_minus_total_protein FROM Laboratory AS l INNER JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.`T-CHO` > 180 GROUP BY p.SEX;

assumptions.assumption: Nonblank DNA values are numeric text; blank DNA values count as missing.
